title: Supported affine member with a compatible stabilized overlap map
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], $W\subseteq X$ a quasi-compact open, $V\subseteq X$ an affine open, and $T\subseteq X$ closed with quasi-compact complement. Choose derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category] with common Hom universe $w$ on $X$ and all its localized open sites, on $W,V$ and all their localized open sites, and on $W\cap V$. Let $E\in D_{QCoh}(\mathcal O_X)$, $R\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, and $\beta:R\to E$. Assume $R$ has strictly perfect neighbourhood models [def-pc-perfect-complex] at every point of $W$ and every cohomology stalk of $R$ vanishes on $W\setminus T$. Let $J_W,J_V$ be direct derived restriction and $S_W,S_V$ transported restriction to $W\cap V$, with canonical comparisons $k_W:J_W\mathbin{\ggg}S_W\cong J_{W\cap V}$ and $k_V:J_V\mathbin{\ggg}S_V\cong J_{W\cap V}$ [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Put $A=J_W(R)\oplus J_W(R)[1]$ and $a=J_W(\beta)\circ\mathrm{pr}_1$. Then $A$ is perfect with vanishing cohomology stalks on $W\setminus T$, and there exist $B\in D(\mathcal O_V)$, $b:B\to J_V(E)$ and $c:S_W(A)\cong S_V(B)$ such that $B$ is perfect with vanishing cohomology stalks on $V\setminus T$ and $(k_W)_E\circ S_W(a)=(k_V)_E\circ S_V(b)\circ c$. No object on the union is asserted.

source.place: Affine construction using Tags 08EK and 08EH before gluing

proof.text: Apply local_perfect_supported_stabilization to R. This gives perfectness and support of its restriction F on W and of A=F plus F[1].

Apply exists_supported_overlap_perfect_extension to F, giving a supported perfect Q on V and q:SV(Q) isomorphic to SW(A). Use exists_compact_overlap_restriction_model to express SV as a compact-open restriction L followed by an exact equivalence e.

Restrict E to the quasi-coherent object EV. Conjugate q.hom followed by SW(a), kW.hom and kV.inv through the natural comparison d:L then e isomorphic to SV, and take the fully faithful preimage. Apply exists_perfect_map_lift_of_isAffine on V. Map the lifting isomorphism through e and conjugate by d to obtain bS:SV(B) isomorphic to SV(Q). The private proved map_lift_transport lemma uses naturality of d to transport the lifting equation. Take c=q inverse followed by bS inverse. Associativity and inverse identities prove the required compatibility. Apply the lifting support clause to the closed inverse image of T in V.

proof_origin.place: Affine extension and map lift; compact-open comparison and naturality calculations made explicit in Lean

theorem exists_supported_affine_overlap_map
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (W V : X.Opens) (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X)) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTc : IsCompact Tᶜ)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ O : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over O))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ O : W.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over O))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ O : V.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over O))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (W ⊓ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (R : schemeDerivedCategory X) (β : R ⟶ E.obj)
    (hR : (∀ x : X, x ∈ W → ∃ O : X.Opens, x ∈ O ∧
        ∃ K : CochainComplex
            (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over O)) ℤ,
          IsStrictlyPerfect X O K ∧
          Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
            (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) O).mapDerivedCategory.obj R ≅
              DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)))
    (hRT : (∀ (i : ℤ) (x : X), x ∈ W → x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj R).val.presheaf x)))) :
    let JW := (schemeOpenRestriction X W).mapDerivedCategory
    let JV := (schemeOpenRestriction X V).mapDerivedCategory
    let SW := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ⟶ W)).mapDerivedCategory
    let SV := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE inf_le_right : W ⊓ V ⟶ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let kW := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ⟶ W)
    let kV := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE inf_le_right : W ⊓ V ⟶ V)
    let A := JW.obj R ⊞ (JW.obj R)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧
    let a : A ⟶ JW.obj E.obj := biprod.fst ≫ JW.map β
    IsPerfect W.toScheme A ∧
      (∀ (i : ℤ) (x : W.toScheme), x.val ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) i).obj A).val.presheaf x))) ∧
      ∃ (B : schemeDerivedCategory V.toScheme) (b : B ⟶ JV.obj E.obj)
        (c : SW.obj A ≅ SV.obj B),
        IsPerfect V.toScheme B ∧
        (∀ (i : ℤ) (x : V.toScheme), x.val ∉ T →
          Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) i).obj B).val.presheaf
              x))) ∧
        SW.map a ≫ kW.hom.app E.obj = c.hom ≫ SV.map b ≫ kV.hom.app E.obj
